_published_faq.name: How do I add MyRace AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MyRace AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.myrace.ai/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is MyRace AI MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, MyRace AI scores 83/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MyRace AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyRace AI provides these MCP tools: get_athlete_insights, get_athlete_result, get_elevation_profile, get_race_info, get_race_results, list_races, and search_athletes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MyRace AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MyRace AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does MyRace AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MyRace AI does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
MyRace AI is developed by MyRace. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
